Hi Samantha and Rajiv,

Thanks again for a great discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: we discussed your latency-sensitive inference workloads, multi-tenant security needs, and the desire to benchmark cost/latency using a few representative prompt sets.
- Goal for next meeting: 60-minute technical demo + Q&A with engineering (we'll show a live inference run, batching/quantization options, and routing/rollout controls).
- Ask: let me know which rotating time slot works best for your team so we can make this a recurring weekly cadence for the pilot phase.

To cover the team globally, here are three rotating slots I propose (we'll shift the weekly meeting by one slot each week so the burden is shared across timezones):

Option A (APAC-friendly one week):
- Tue 23:00 SGT / Wed 03:00 AEDT / Tue 07:00 PDT (US West)
Option B (EMEA-friendly one week):
- Wed 09:00 BST / Wed 10:00 CEST / Tue 01:00 PDT
Option C (US-friendly one week):
- Thu 10:00 PDT / Thu 13:00 EDT / Thu 18:00 BST

Practical notes:
- Each session will be recorded and we can rotate presenters so both of your engineering leads can attend at least every other week.
- If a recurring weekly slot feels heavy, we can do a 1:1 technical deep dive (90 min) once and then move to biweekly check-ins.

Can you reply with which of these three rotation preferences you'd pick (A/B/C) and which folks you want on the invite? I cc'd Aditya from our solutions team so he can join the demo and handle any environment-specific questions.

Attached: a short prep doc with example prompts and data shapes (Redwood_Demo_Prep.pdf). I'll also attach a provisional calendar .ics once we confirm the slot.
